name: ivygrep
description: Local code search and relationship-aware context packs for coding agents
long_description: Search source by intent or exact identifiers and build bounded task packs from branch changes, definitions, callers, dependents, tests, configuration, and documentation. Source, queries, embeddings, and indexes stay local.

tools.name: ig_search
tools.description: Search local code or build one bounded task context pack

tools.name: ig_status
tools.description: Inspect local ivygrep indexes and indexing state
